Cualquier otro asunto que no se espere razonablemente dentro de 48 horas
review: items 2: The Spanish says 'que no se espere razonablemente dentro de 48 horas', which reads as if the item itself is not expected within 48 hours. The English means business that could not reasonably have been anticipated 48 hours before the meeting. 'Dentro de 48 horas' means 'within 48 hours from now' and reverses the timing, so the meaning changes.
